name: How long does a new roof last with different materials?

mainEntity.name: How long does a new roof last with different materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a new roof varies significantly by material. Standard asphalt shingles typically last 20-30 years, while architectural or designer asphalt shingles can extend to 30-50 years. Metal roofs are known for exceptional longevity, often lasting 40-70 years, and some even longer with proper maintenance. TPO and PVC roofs, commonly used on commercial or flat residential properties, generally last 15-30 years. Discounted Roofing Co. provides specific warranty information for each material option discussed during your consultation, ensuring you understand its expected performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Asphalt shingles last 20-50 years depending on type, metal roofs 40-70 years, and TPO/PVC roofs 15-30 years. Lifespans vary by material and quality.
